agents.title: Leads Agent
agents.purpose: Finds leads, buyers, and partnership targets.
agents.tip: Pull leads by role, industry, company size, and buying intent.
agents.outputs: Ranked lead list with role, industry, company size, buying-intent evidence, and a suggested opening line per lead.

agents.title: Research Agent
agents.purpose: Finds market signals and source-backed research.
agents.outputs: Patterns with named sources and confidence per claim — never unsourced summaries.

agents.title: Docs Agent
agents.purpose: Organizes docs, SOPs, and knowledge bases.
agents.tip: Keep all repeatable work inside structured pages.
agents.outputs: Updated or newly structured pages plus an index diff of what moved where.

agents.title: Ads Agent
agents.purpose: Creates ad concepts and campaign assets.
agents.best_for: Ads, creatives, motion concepts, and visual campaigns.
agents.tip: Turn product angles into scroll-stopping creative briefs.
agents.outputs: Creative briefs: hook, angle, visual direction, copy variants, and the offer each maps to.

agents.title: Content Agent
agents.purpose: Turns ideas into posts, scripts, and visual briefs.
agents.tip: Feed it style-rules.md before every draft.
agents.outputs: Channel-ready drafts in the operator's voice, each with a one-line rationale and a proof point.

agents.title: Sales Agent
agents.purpose: Writes outreach, follow-ups, and deal notes.
agents.best_for: Sponsors, clients, partnerships, and deal flow.
agents.tip: Anchor every reply with one recent proof point.
agents.outputs: Ready-to-send messages plus deal notes: stage, next step, and the proof point used.

agents.title: Product Agent
agents.purpose: Turns customer pain into roadmap items.
agents.best_for: Solo builders shipping tools or digital products.
agents.tip: Turn repeated requests into roadmap tickets.
agents.outputs: Roadmap tickets: pain evidence, affected users, proposed scope, and effort guess.

agents.title: Ops Agent
agents.purpose: Runs workflows, SOPs, and weekly planning.
agents.tip: Every repeated task becomes a process file.
agents.outputs: Updated process files and a weekly plan draft; flags any task done twice without an SOP.

agents.title: Finance Agent
agents.purpose: Tracks revenue, pricing, and cash decisions.
agents.tip: Ask what decision changes cash flow this month.
agents.outputs: Decision memos: the one decision that changes cash flow this month, options, and numbers behind each.

agents.title: Review Agent
agents.purpose: Checks voice, accuracy, and ship quality.
agents.best_for: Keeping the human in the decision seat.
agents.tip: Never publish before the review agent runs the "anyone test".
agents.outputs: SHIP or FIX FIRST verdict with numbered issues tied to the review-prompt checklist. The human makes the final call.
